category_title: Reintegrated learners with BESD exhibiting social-emotional dysregulation and authority defiance
scenario_title: Avoiding mainstream lessons through over-reliance on a significant adult
minimal_context: The student is sitting with a support staff member instead of attending their scheduled mainstream lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for you to head back to your mainstream math lesson now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not going. If I have problems I can go straight to the teachers, so I'm staying here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to attend your scheduled classes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Look mate, I'm just going to sit here with you. I don't want to go to that lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We cannot just sit here. You have to go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said no! You're supposed to let me stay here whenever I want. I'm not going back to that class, so just leave it alone.
